mentions.name: devz.cl
mentions.description: A personal website where the author writes once a day, sharing gamedev ideas, stories, and reflections on software and life. It is built as a static site and includes indie web features such as webmentions (via webmentions.io) that work without requiring a server.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just started trying to write once a day in my website https://devz.cl

I set it up a few months ago to share gamedev, ideas, stories.
